promo.title: Minicraft is live
promo.text: Your launcher, your cape, your menus. Edit this banner any time by changing news.json on GitHub.

news.title: New Minecraft menus
news.text: The title screen and the ESC menu have a new look in game on 1.21.7.

news.title: Build your own HUD
news.text: Press Esc in game, click Mini Client and pick what shows on the bar: FPS, CPS, ping, coordinates, clock.

news.title: Capes
news.text: Add your own cape PNG in Settings. Only you can see it.
